name: llamhigyn y dwr

attributes.attribute: a giant toad of the deep

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Llamhigyn y dwr is the Welsh water leaper. It is a monster that moves in the water with the shape of a giant toad. It is a kin of the WATER BULL and the WATER HORSE. The beast hid under the surface until a man or an ox passed by. Then it sprang out and gripped the prey and dragged it down to feed. A plain crossing of a river could end in a sudden death in Welsh lore.

okr.objective: Record the Welsh water leaper Llamhigyn y dwr.
key_results: Give its shape and kindred beasts.
Tell how it leaps on and drags its prey.
Set the danger of a plain water crossing.
